'''TVS Supply Chain Solutions''' ('''TVS SCS''') is an Indian multinational [[Transport|transportation]], [[logistics]] and [[Warehouse|warehousing]] company. It provides [[supply chain management]] services to customers in the automotive, consumer goods, defence and utility sectors in India, the United Kingdom, Europe and the US. It is part of the [[TVS Group]] of companies.

== History ==

The company began in 1995 as '''TVS Logistics''', a division of [[TVS Group|TVS & Sons]], before being hived off as a separate company in 2004 as '''TVS Logistics Services Ltd.''' ('''TVS LSL'''). In 2004 it bought out the UK based CJ Components – an automotive component sourcing company. The company pursued further acquisitions across Europe, the UK, the USA, Singapore and Australia.

In 2009, TVS LSL acquired Multipart Holding,<ref>{{Cite news |date=Nov 11, 2009 |title=TVS-LSL acquires Multipart Holding |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/companies/TVS-LSL-acquires-Multipart-Holding/article16891443.ece}}</ref> which is among the top three after market logistics companies in UK.<ref>{{Cite news |date=Nov 11, 2009 |title=TVS Logistics acquires UK's Multipart Holding |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tvs-logistics-acquires-uks-multipart-holding/articleshow/5220118.cms}}</ref> With the Multipart acquisition, TVS LSL formed a European subsidiary, TVS Supply Chain Solutions (TVS SCS) from JC and Multipart. This was followed in 2012 by the acquisition of same day courier and IT support and logistics firm [[Rico Logistics]] for {{INRConvert|100|c|lk=on|to=GBP|year=2012|mode=historical}}. Rico operated as a subsidiary of TVS SCS<ref>{{Cite news |last=Sushma |first=U N |date=Feb 21, 2013 |title=TVS Logistics acquires UK-based Rico Logistics |work=Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/tvs-logistics-acquires-uk-based-rico-logistics/articleshow/18610027.cms |url-status=live |access-date=Feb 18, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160106225740/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/TVS-Logistics-acquires-UK-based-Rico-Logistics/articleshow/18610027.cms |archive-date=Jan 6, 2016}}</ref> and was renamed TVS SCS Rico in  2017.<ref name="Allen 2018">{{Cite report |url=http://www.ftc2050.com/reports/ftc2050-2018-Same-day_delivery_market_UK.pdf |title=An Analysis of the Same-Day Delivery Market and Operations in the UK |last1=Allen |first1=Julian |last2=Piecyk |first2=Maja |date=Nov 2018 |publisher=University of Westminster |last3=Piotrowska |first3=Marzena |access-date=Feb 18, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220218204100/http://www.ftc2050.com/reports/ftc2050-2018-Same-day_delivery_market_UK.pdf |archive-date=Feb 18, 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref>

TVS Logistics was then renamed to '''TVS Supply Chain Solutions'''<ref>{{Cite news |title=The buyout firm will purchase new shares as well as those held by existing shareholders in TVS Supply Chain |agency=BloombergQuint |url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/pe-firm-is-said-in-advanced-talks-for-tvs-supply-chain-stake}}</ref> in 2019.

In 2020, [[Mitsubishi Corporation]] invested in TVS Supply Chain Solutions for minority stake.<ref>{{Cite news |date=Nov 11, 2020 |title=Mitsubishi Corp invests in TVS Supply Chain Solutions for minority stake |publisher=Mint |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/mitsubishi-corp-invests-in-tvs-supply-chain-solutions-for-minority-stake-11605032799855.html}}</ref>

In August 2023, the company launched its [[initial public offering]] and got listed on the Indian stock exchanges.<ref name="fy23"/>
